name: draw_on_screen
description: Draw directly on the student's screen or lecture slide, on what is already there: circle a term, underline a phrase, highlight a definition, box a structure, arrow to a step, and connect parts with labelled arrows. Target each mark by quoting the exact visible words (quote), or by a regionId from the screen map. Animated like handwriting; Yoyo flies to the first mark. Build an explanation with several calls (clear:false) as you speak. If the content is on screen, annotate it here instead of redrawing it in a sketch. Never announce it (no "Let me draw", "I'll sketch", "Let's look at"); talk about the subject while it appears.

quote.description: Exact visible words to mark (two to eight words, copied as written on screen or slide). Preferred.

regionId.description: Alternatively, a regionId from the screen map.

label.description: Optional few-word label, up to 60 characters.

connections.description: Up to 6 labelled arrows between two regions.

from.description: Start: an exact visible quote or a regionId.

to.description: End: an exact visible quote or a regionId.

clear.description: true replaces your previous drawing; false adds to it.
